messages: erin_design: dropped a tiny pattern for inline tool-swaps in run history — small 'Change' pill on the run row, opens a compact picker. mock: https://redwood.mock/s/inline-swap-v2.png mike_devex: looks lightweight. main question: how do we show the before/after in the run item so auditability isn't lost? paul_pm: must show original tool and changed tool with actor + time. propose a tiny provenance line: 'changed: grammar-check → llm-proxy by erin_design · 2m'. sara_a11y: accessibility checklist: - 'Change' must have aria-label like "Change tool for invocation 1745067890" - the picker should be reachable via keyboard and announce when opened (aria-live polite) - any chevrons must reflect aria-expanded true/false - ensure color contrast on the pill and the provenance text jon_engineer: impl notes: we'll lazy-load tool metadata on open and cache by id. example snippet we can use: ```html changed: grammar-check → llm-proxy · @erin_design ``` ux-research: ran a 10-person quick test — people liked inline for quick swaps but wanted a clear way to see full schema. suggestion: small 'View signature' link that opens the inspector (non-blocking). erin_design: copy options for toast after change: - "Tool updated — rerun to apply" - "Tool changed (not applied). Rerun to execute with new tool." Thoughts on aut0-run? mike_devex: prefer not to auto-rerun. non-blocking toast with a primary 'Rerun' action is best. also track metric: % of swaps with rerun within 30s. paul_pm: agree — don't auto-run for deterministic logs. also record swap events in audit stream. sara_a11y: microcopy: include target run index in aria-labels for clarity. also ensure toast is dismissible and exposed to screen readers. jon_engineer: will wire event: {type: 'tool_swap', from: 'grammar-check', to: 'llm-proxy', actor: 'erin_design', ts: 1745067890} — logs, and UI shows provenance pill. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: playground/inline-swap branch deployed to staging (build 7089)
